product: Flagstar Ready Checking / Flagstar Elite Checking
availability_verbatim: Arizona, California, Florida, Indiana, Michigan, New Jersey, New York, Ohio, and Wisconsin

requirements.verbatim: Have one or more direct deposits totaling $500 or more
Maintain an average daily balance of $500+
Minimum $50 deposit to open checking account

fee_waiver: Ready Checking: no fee with eStatements enrollment (or as of 5/1/26, $10 fee reduced to $5 with one, waived with two, of: eStatements, $500+ DD, $1,000+ avg balance, or age <=24). Elite Checking: $15 fee waived with active military/veteran status OR $25,000 avg daily balance in combined Flagstar accounts

churn.limit_language_verbatim: If you have been paid a checking cash bonus previously, you are ineligible to receive this offer; limited to one checking bonus per household
